postgres_requirements.rationale: Every control in this amendment is a Real-PG proof and none can be discharged without a live PostgreSQL. Both harness paths are legitimately UNKNOWN at this base for the same measured reason the base manifest records: the repository carries TWO admissible real-PG shapes -- suites pairing a *.pg.test.ts with a *-harness.ts and *.probes.json, and suites carrying neither (tests/postgres/ce1-commercial-account.pg.test.ts) -- so naming a probes.json path now would be a fabricated fact. What IS frozen and may not vary: the cluster is DISPOSABLE ONLY (scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts or tests/postgres/disposable-db.ts, gated UELLIX_PG_TESTS=1, skipped never silently passed; throwaway container on 127.0.0.1, ephemeral port, no bind mounts, teardown in finally, leftover check); never staging, never production, never the canonical local stack; and the substrate carries NO ad-hoc GRANT (parent SECTION_13 PROHIBITED_IN_THE_SUBSTRATE). That last prohibition is load-bearing here specifically: the only place in the repository where uellix_app can reach auth.uid() today is an ad-hoc harness grant, and importing it would convert PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID from a test into an assumption. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts (+ optional current-schema-runtime-acl.probes.json). A further measured hazard for whoever writes the probe loop: docker exec costs roughly 250 ms on the reference host, so a loop of 25-58 probes exceeds vitest's default 5000 ms timeout and must be run with an explicit --testTimeout rather than trimmed.

sentinels.purpose: A uniquely-valued row planted for the SIBLING SUBJECT on each of the 14 relations covered by PG-17A, where 'subject' is resolved per relation by that relation's ACTUAL discriminator: ORG_B for the 13 organization-scoped relations, and USER_B for account_legal_acceptances. Under the own subject's identity context as uellix_app it must never appear in any result set; its presence in the sibling's OWN result set is the positive half that proves the negative half is not vacuous. This sentinel supersedes the base manifest's SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_ROW for the amended arms, because that sentinel is defined as 'planted in ORG_B on each of the 18 readable tables' and cannot be planted at all on the four platform-global relations (no organization_id) or on account_legal_acceptances (no organization_id). For financial_proxy_versions the sibling row MUST carry organization_id IS NOT NULL, or it falls into the global class governed by PG-17B and the isolation assertion inverts.

A uniquely-valued governed reference row planted on each of the four PG-17B platform-global relations (governed_model_registry, proxy_material_fields_registry, legal_instruments, legal_instrument_versions), owned by no organization and no user because those relations carry no such column. It is the known-positive instrument control for PG-17B: an assertion that identity A and identity B 'see the same governed set' is trivially satisfied by both seeing NOTHING, so a cross-identity set-equality result over an empty registry has proven exactly nothing. This sentinel's presence in BOTH result sets is what makes the equality substantive. It must also be absent from the identity-free result set, which is how the same sentinel serves the negative arm. M-PG17-03 falsifies it by removal.

A uniquely-valued row planted on financial_proxy_versions with organization_id IS NULL AND review_status = 'approved', i.e. exactly the row class the first disjunct of financial_proxy_versions_select (db/migrations/0053_fib_proxy_versions_provenance.sql:114) deliberately publishes to any authenticated identity. It proves the approved-global arm is REACHED, which is the precise fact that makes the parent's 'returns only ORG_A rows' false for this relation. Its two-term predicate is load-bearing: a control that planted only organization_id IS NULL, without pinning review_status, would stay green while unapproved global rows were published -- the exact governance failure the policy's conjunction exists to prevent. M-PG17-06 falsifies it by flipping review_status to a non-approved state. This sentinel must never be reused to satisfy a PG-17A assertion about the same relation.

positive_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent. ORG_ARM TWO_SIDED_ISOLATION, 13 RELATIONS, BOTH DIRECTIONS. As uellix_app under ORG_A's identity context, a SELECT on each of the 13 organization-scoped relations (domain_object_versions, evidence_sufficiency_determinations, evidence_tombstones, readiness_assessments, sensitivity_scenarios, assumption_object_links, organization_commercial_acceptances, evidence_versions, financial_proxy_versions, outcome_monetization_dispositions, counterfactual_assessments, methodological_assumptions, sensitivity_candidates) returns ORG_A's OWN fixture row and never SENTINEL_SIBLING_SUBJECT_ROW planted in ORG_B; and symmetrically, under ORG_B's identity context, returns ORG_B's own row and never ORG_A's. BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE REQUIRED and one alone does not satisfy this control. THE OWN-ROW HALF IS NOT DECORATIVE: an EMPTY result set does not satisfy the sibling-absent assertion, because an empty set is also what a connection returns when identity was never established, when the statement errored, or when the fixture never landed. The assertion must establish that the own row IS present in the SAME result set in which the sibling row is absent, and must match the own row by its sentinel-bearing VALUE rather than by a row COUNT, since a count of 1 cannot distinguish the own row from the sibling row. FIXTURE CONSTRAINT, BINDING, for financial_proxy_versions only: both tenant fixture rows MUST be written with organization_id IS NOT NULL. That column is NULLABLE on this relation and its SELECT policy publishes an unconditional approved-global arm, so a tenant fixture left NULL would be visible to BOTH organizations by design and would turn this control RED against a CORRECT implementation. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A4 ORG_ARM and FINANCIAL_PROXY_VERSIONS_FIXTURE_CONSTRAINT. Falsified by M-PG17-01. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent; PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID relevant (this relation's policy calls auth.uid() DIRECTLY, not through a SECURITY DEFINER helper). USER_ARM TWO_SIDED_SUBJECT_ISOLATION ON account_legal_acceptances, BOTH DIRECTIONS. As uellix_app under USER_A's identity context, a SELECT on account_legal_acceptances returns USER_A's own acceptance row and never SENTINEL_SIBLING_SUBJECT_ROW planted for USER_B; symmetrically for USER_B. THE DISCRIMINATOR IS user_id AND NOT organization_id: this relation has NO organization_id column at all (db/migrations/0070_customer_lifecycle_cl1_legal_acceptance.sql CREATE TABLE account_legal_acceptances -- id, user_id, instrument_version_id, content_digest, accepted_at, audit_log_id), and its policy is account_legal_acceptances_select (line 141) TO uellix_app USING (user_id = auth.uid()). A control that varied the ORGANIZATION here would be a category error and would not satisfy this control. MANDATORY ATTRIBUTION GUARD, BINDING: USER_A and USER_B MUST be members of the SAME organization. Without co-membership a green result is ambiguous -- the row could have been filtered by the user_id predicate as intended, or by an organization boundary elsewhere in the stack -- and the control would be attributing its own result to the wrong cause. Co-membership removes the alternative explanation. Same-result-set and value-matching requirements as PG-17A-P-1 apply unchanged. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A4 USER_ARM and D-2. Falsified by M-PG17-02. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent; PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID OPEN. GOVERNED GLOBAL ROW EXISTS AND IDENTITY A SEES IT. Discharges authority amendment SECTION_A5 properties B1 and B2 together, and the conjunction is the control. (1) SENTINEL_GOVERNED_GLOBAL_ROW ACTUALLY EXISTS on each of the four platform-global relations (governed_model_registry, proxy_material_fields_registry, legal_instruments, legal_instrument_versions) and SENTINEL_GLOBAL_APPROVED_PROXY_VERSION actually exists on financial_proxy_versions with organization_id IS NULL AND review_status = 'approved' -- asserted, not assumed from fixture setup, because an empty covered surface makes every downstream visibility claim vacuous. (2) As uellix_app under authenticated identity A, a SELECT on each of the five covered surfaces RETURNS that sentinel row, matched by its sentinel-bearing value. These five surfaces carry NO tenant discriminator to filter on -- the four registries have neither organization_id nor a visibility-bearing user column, and their sole policy predicate is auth.uid() IS NOT NULL -- so visibility here is correct behaviour and not a leak. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 and D-1/D-3. Falsified by M-PG17-03 and M-PG17-06. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent; PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID OPEN. CROSS-IDENTITY SET EQUALITY. Discharges authority amendment SECTION_A5 property B3. As uellix_app under authenticated identity B -- an identity belonging to a DIFFERENT organization from identity A -- a SELECT on each of the five covered surfaces returns the SAME governed set that identity A received under PG-17B-P-1. EQUALITY OF THE TWO SETS IS THE ASSERTION, and this is the control that carries the whole point of the correction: for these surfaces, cross-identity IDENTITY of the result set is the CORRECT property, and the parent authority's demand for cross-identity DIFFERENCE was the defect. NON-VACUITY IS REQUIRED: the equality must be asserted over a NON-EMPTY set whose membership includes SENTINEL_GOVERNED_GLOBAL_ROW (and SENTINEL_GLOBAL_APPROVED_PROXY_VERSION for financial_proxy_versions), because two empty sets are trivially equal and such a result would prove nothing. Identity B must be a genuinely different organization's identity, so that a stack which silently filtered by organization would be caught rather than accommodated. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 B3. Falsified by M-PG17-03. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent. APPROVED-GLOBAL ROW CLASS OF financial_proxy_versions IS REACHED AND IS PREDICATE-PRECISE. Proves that the first disjunct of financial_proxy_versions_select (db/migrations/0053_fib_proxy_versions_provenance.sql:114 -- (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NULL AND review_status = 'approved')) is LIVE: under ORG_A's identity context as uellix_app, the result set for financial_proxy_versions contains BOTH ORG_A's own tenant row (organization_id IS NOT NULL, per PG-17A-P-1's fixture constraint) AND SENTINEL_GLOBAL_APPROVED_PROXY_VERSION. THIS IS THE CONTROL THAT MAKES THE PARENT'S DEFECT CONCRETE: the parent clause 'returns only ORG_A rows' would be RED against this correct behaviour, which is why D-3 adjudicates it as false for this relation as a whole. THE TWO-TERM PREDICATE IS LOAD-BEARING: the control must establish that the visible global row is BOTH organization_id IS NULL AND review_status = 'approved'. A control that checked only nullability would remain green while unapproved global rows were published, which is precisely the governance failure the policy's conjunction exists to prevent. THE TWO ARMS MUST NOT SHARE A FIXTURE ROW: the tenant row proving PG-17A and the global row proving PG-17B are distinct rows, or one of the two arms is vacuous. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 COVERED_ROW_CLASS and D-3. Falsified by M-PG17-06. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

negative_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent. SIBLING ORGANIZATION ROW IS REFUSED, NON-VACUOUSLY, ON ALL 13. For each of the 13 organization-scoped relations and in BOTH directions, SENTINEL_SIBLING_SUBJECT_ROW planted in the sibling organization is ABSENT from the result set returned under the own organization's identity context as uellix_app. THE ANTI-VACUITY CONDITION IS PART OF THE CONTROL: the absence assertion is only admissible in a result set that is simultaneously proven to CONTAIN the own row (PG-17A-P-1), because an empty result set satisfies 'sibling absent' for every wrong reason -- no identity, an error swallowed by the harness, a fixture that never landed. A specific measured hazard to guard: a statement list that establishes identity via SELECT set_config(...) returns the set_config echo value as a row, so a result set can appear non-empty while containing no row from the relation under test; the assertion must match rows of the relation by their sentinel-bearing value, never merely observe that something came back. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A4 REQUIRED_PROPERTIES_FOR_EVERY_ONE_OF_THE_14 and EMPTY_RESULT_HAZARD_NAMED. Falsified by M-PG17-01. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent; PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID relevant. SIBLING USER ROW IS REFUSED ON account_legal_acceptances, AND THE REFUSAL IS ATTRIBUTABLE TO user_id. In both directions, SENTINEL_SIBLING_SUBJECT_ROW planted for the sibling USER is ABSENT from the result set returned under the own user's identity context as uellix_app, while the own user's row IS present in that same result set. ATTRIBUTION IS THE POINT OF THIS CONTROL AND NOT A REFINEMENT OF IT: because USER_A and USER_B are co-members of the SAME organization (PG-17A-P-2's mandatory guard), no organization boundary exists that could explain the isolation, so the only surviving explanation is the user_id = auth.uid() predicate of account_legal_acceptances_select. A version of this control run with the two users in different organizations would be satisfied by the wrong mechanism and is explicitly not this control. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A4 USER_ARM MANDATORY_ATTRIBUTION_GUARD and D-2. Falsified by M-PG17-02. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent; PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID OPEN AND DIRECTLY DETERMINATIVE OF THIS CONTROL. IDENTITY-FREE CONTEXT RETURNS ZERO ROWS AND NO SQLSTATE. Discharges authority amendment SECTION_A5 property B4. As uellix_app with NO identity established, a SELECT on each of the four platform-global relations returns ZERO ROWS and raises NO SQLSTATE. THE DISTINCTION BETWEEN ZERO ROWS AND AN ERROR IS THE ENTIRE CONTROL: zero rows means the policy predicate auth.uid() IS NOT NULL correctly evaluated to false and the row was filtered; an error means the invoking role could not evaluate the policy at all. These outcomes look identical to a test that asserts only 'nothing came back' or that catches any throwable and reports 'refused', and they have OPPOSITE meanings for whether the governed ACL contract is correct. SPECIFICALLY PROHIBITED AS A PASS: 'permission denied for schema auth'. That is the exact symptom PRE-PG17B-AUTHUID exists to detect, and it must be reported as BLOCKED rather than as a refusal. If this control observes that symptom, the implementation lane STOPS and escalates for a SECTION_5 authority successor; it does NOT grant USAGE ON SCHEMA auth or EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid() to uellix_writer, uellix_app or uellix_auditor to obtain a green, and it does NOT import the ad-hoc harness grant at tests/postgres/legal-acceptance-fixtures.ts:89-91 into the governed substrate (parent SECTION_13 PROHIBITED_IN_THE_SUBSTRATE forbids exactly that shape). Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 B4 and SECTION_A6. Falsified by M-PG17-05. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent. RUNTIME MUTATION PRIVILEGES ARE ABSENT IN THE CATALOG. Discharges authority amendment SECTION_A5 property B5. has_table_privilege(uellix_app, <relation>, v) is FALSE for v in (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on each of the four platform-global relations -- read from the catalog, asserted per verb and per relation, twelve assertions with no aggregation that could let one FALSE stand in for another. These four relations are READ_ONLY in the parent SECTION_2 classification and are seeded by migrator identity only (db/migrations/0040:33, 0055:43, 0056:28, 0056:102); registry versioning is a governed administrative act, not a runtime writer act, so a runtime write privilege on any of them is a widening no authority has granted. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 B5. Falsified by M-PG17-04. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. BLOCKED_BY: stella_0021 absent. LIVE MUTATION ATTEMPTS ARE REFUSED, AND THE REFUSAL IS ATTRIBUTED TO THE PRIVILEGE LAYER. Discharges authority amendment SECTION_A5 property B6 together with its REFUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIREMENT. An ACTUAL INSERT, an ACTUAL UPDATE and an ACTUAL DELETE attempted as uellix_app against each of the four platform-global relations are REFUSED. B5 AND B6 ARE BOTH REQUIRED AND NEITHER SUBSTITUTES FOR THE OTHER: a catalog predicate can read FALSE while a live path still succeeds through some other grant, and a live refusal can arise from a cause entirely unrelated to privilege. ATTRIBUTION IS MANDATORY AND SQLSTATE ALONE DOES NOT SUPPLY IT: 42501 is not a unique signature of a missing GRANT, because an RLS WITH CHECK violation also raises 42501 and is evaluated BEFORE NOT NULL and foreign-key constraints, so a fixture row that would have failed for an unrelated reason produces the same code. A control asserting only the code can therefore be satisfied by a database whose GRANT layer is wide open. The attribution is discharged by pairing each live refusal with the PG-17B-N-2 catalog predicate for the same relation and verb, so that the absence of the privilege is established independently of the code the attempt returned. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A5 B6 and REFUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIREMENT. Falsified by M-PG17-04. INTENDED file: tests/postgres/current-schema-runtime-acl.pg.test.ts.

mutation_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the real tenant discriminator on one organization-scoped relation. ACTION: break the organization discriminator on EXACTLY ONE of the 13 ORG_SCOPED relations -- for example by widening its SELECT policy's tenant predicate so it no longer restricts to the caller's organizations. REQUIRED OUTCOME: PG-17A-P-1 and PG-17A-N-1 RED for that relation, in both directions. WHAT IT PROVES: the ORG_ARM is actually reading the discriminator rather than passing for an incidental reason. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY: the mutation anchor MUST assert it matches EXACTLY ONE site before mutating. An anchor that also matches a sibling relation or a second occurrence mutates a surface other than the one under test, so the resulting RED is attributed to the wrong control -- or the intended site is left unmutated and the resulting GREEN is misread as robustness. A match count other than one aborts the harness before any mutation is applied. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-01 and ANCHOR_UNIQUENESS_REQUIREMENT.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the same-organization co-membership of USER_A and USER_B. ACTION: place USER_A and USER_B in DIFFERENT organizations for the account_legal_acceptances fixture. REQUIRED OUTCOME: the PG-17A USER_ARM attribution guard RED (PG-17A-P-2 / PG-17A-N-2). WHAT IT PROVES: the USER_ARM is proving user_id isolation specifically and would notice if its result became attributable to an organization boundary instead. Without this mutation the co-membership requirement would be an unenforced stylistic preference that any later fixture refactor could silently drop, restoring the ambiguity D-2 exists to remove. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY as in M-PG17-01. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-02.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the existence of the governed global sentinel row. ACTION: remove SENTINEL_GOVERNED_GLOBAL_ROW from one PG-17B platform-global relation. REQUIRED OUTCOME: PG-17B-P-1 RED for that relation, and PG-17B-P-2 RED because its cross-identity set-equality assertion loses its non-empty membership. WHAT IT PROVES: PG-17B's positive arm is not vacuously satisfied by an empty registry and its set-equality is not the trivial equality of two empty sets -- the single most likely way for PG-17B to appear green while proving nothing. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY as in M-PG17-01. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-03.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the absence of runtime write capability on a global registry. ACTION: grant a forbidden write capability (INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE) to uellix_app on one of the four PLATFORM_GLOBAL relations. REQUIRED OUTCOME: PG-17B-N-2 RED (the catalog predicate for that relation and verb turns TRUE) AND PG-17B-N-3 RED (the live attempt for that relation and verb succeeds). BOTH MUST GO RED: that is what proves the two layers are independently load-bearing rather than one being a restatement of the other. WHAT IT PROVES: neither the catalog assertion nor the live attempt is decorative, and a real widening of the runtime's capability on a governed registry cannot pass unnoticed. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY as in M-PG17-01. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-04.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the identity-free condition of the negative arm. ACTION: install an identity in the arm that is supposed to run WITHOUT one. REQUIRED OUTCOME: PG-17B-N-1 RED -- the covered surfaces begin returning SENTINEL_GOVERNED_GLOBAL_ROW instead of zero rows. WHAT IT PROVES: PG-17B-N-1 is genuinely measuring an identity-free context and would not remain green if an identity leaked into it. That leak is the realistic contamination for a suite which establishes identity for most of its other assertions and may reuse a connection or a session setting across arms. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY as in M-PG17-01. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-05.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GUARANTEE REMOVED: the approved state of the global financial_proxy_versions sentinel. ACTION: change SENTINEL_GLOBAL_APPROVED_PROXY_VERSION to a non-approved review_status -- for example 'draft', which the financial_proxy_versions_review_status_check constraint admits, so the mutation produces a legal row and not a constraint failure that would mask the intended signal. REQUIRED OUTCOME: PG-17B-P-3 RED, and the PG-17B arm of PG-17B-P-1 RED for financial_proxy_versions. WHAT IT PROVES: the control is reading review_status = 'approved' and not merely organization_id IS NULL. Without this mutation, a control that checked only nullability would stay green while unapproved global rows were published to every authenticated identity -- the exact governance failure the policy's two-term conjunction exists to prevent, and the one that a nullability-only assertion is structurally blind to. ANCHOR UNIQUENESS IS MANDATORY as in M-PG17-01. Authorized by authority amendment SECTION_A7 M-PG17-06.
